tooltip.skillcraft.emberfall_maul.sunder: Sunder: fully charged hits make the target take 15% more damage from everyone for 6s
tooltip.skillcraft.emberfall_maul.weight: Two-handed, and heavy: -10% movement speed while held
tooltip.skillcraft.ember_sigil: Use on a Summoning Brazier to face Slagheart, the Forge Warden. Reusable.

message.skillcraft.slagheart_phase2: Slagheart's fire is stoked! Cinder Mites feed its heat - break them first.
message.skillcraft.slagheart_mites: Cinder Mites swarm out of the forge. Slagheart takes half damage while they live.
message.skillcraft.slagheart_enrage_warn: Slagheart's plates glow white. It will soon overheat!
message.skillcraft.slagheart_defeated: Slagheart's heart gutters out. The forge falls silent.
message.skillcraft.arena_lobby: The Sunken Forge antechamber. Gather here, then walk through the gate to face Slagheart. The Exit Portal behind you leads home.
message.skillcraft.arena_reformed: The forge roars back to life. Slagheart has reformed.
message.skillcraft.arena_victory: Victory! Claim your loot from the Reward Chest. Slagheart reforms in %s seconds.
message.skillcraft.arena_victory_no_loot: Victory! You didn't deal enough damage for a share of the loot. Slagheart reforms in %s seconds.
message.skillcraft.arena_defeated: Slagheart bested you. Your belongings are safe, but this attempt is lost.
message.skillcraft.arena_returned: You were returned from the arena.
message.skillcraft.arena_unavailable: The way to the arena is closed (arena dimension missing).
message.skillcraft.brazier_hint: The brazier needs an Ember Sigil.
message.skillcraft.reward_chest_empty: There's nothing in the chest for you.
ability.skillcraft.lunge.desc: Dash forward and strike the first enemy in your path.
ability.skillcraft.hamstring.desc: A low cut that slows your target to a crawl.
ability.skillcraft.rending_cut.desc: A tearing slash that leaves the target bleeding.
ability.skillcraft.sweeping_arc.desc: A wide cleave that hits everything in front of you.
ability.skillcraft.battle_trance.desc: Lose yourself in the fight: hit much harder, but guard yourself less.
ability.skillcraft.quick_draw.desc: Your next bow shot is fully drawn the moment you loose it.
ability.skillcraft.pinning_shot.desc: Your next shot pins its target in place.
ability.skillcraft.tumble.desc: Roll away from danger; your next shot hits harder.
ability.skillcraft.volley.desc: Loose a fan of arrows at once.
ability.skillcraft.deadeye.desc: For a short time your arrows fly true and hit harder. Heavy arrows punch through.
ability.skillcraft.brace.desc: Set your feet and take far less damage for a moment.
ability.skillcraft.riposte.desc: Parry the next blow, then answer it with a crushing counter.
ability.skillcraft.unshackle.desc: Shrug off slows, roots and stuns, and ignore them briefly.
ability.skillcraft.second_wind.desc: Catch your breath and recover health over a few seconds.
ability.skillcraft.bulwark.desc: Harden your guard and turn part of each melee blow back on the attacker.
ability.skillcraft.last_stand.desc: Nothing can take more than a fifth of your health in one hit, and nothing moves you.
ability.skillcraft.concussive_blow.desc: A ringing hammer blow that stuns (bosses are only dazed).
ability.skillcraft.earthbreaker.desc: Slam the ground, crushing and slowing everything around you.
ability.skillcraft.vault.desc: Plant your spear and vault forward, clearing hazards on the ground.
ability.skillcraft.skewer.desc: A long thrust that runs through every enemy in a line.
ability.skillcraft.cleaving_chop.desc: A heavy chop that knocks a raised shield out of use.
ability.skillcraft.shield_bash.desc: Bash with your shield to interrupt and shove the target.
ability.skillcraft.piercing_bolt.desc: Your next bolt drives through several enemies.
ability.skillcraft.forgequake.desc: Bring the maul down like a forge hammer: a huge slam that sunders everything it hits.
ability.skillcraft.fireball.desc: Hurl a ball of fire that bursts on impact, setting everything nearby alight.
ability.skillcraft.hearthward.desc: Channel for a few seconds, then return to your bed. Can't be cast in combat or in an arena.
ability.skillcraft.rime_snare.desc: A bolt of frost that freezes its target in place.
ability.skillcraft.blink.desc: Vanish and reappear a short way ahead, wherever you look.
ability.skillcraft.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that leaps from your target to the enemies around it.
ability.skillcraft.arcane_ward.desc: Wrap yourself in a shell of raw magic that soaks up damage.
ability.skillcraft.frost_nova.desc: A burst of ice around you that chills and slows everything near.
ability.skillcraft.starfall.desc: Call down a falling star on the spot you're aiming at.
ability.skillcraft.sidestep.desc: A quick dash the way you're moving, or backwards if you're standing still.
ability.skillcraft.featherfall.desc: Drift down gently for a few seconds.
ability.skillcraft.updraft.desc: Kick off the air itself and spring upwards, even mid-jump.
ability.skillcraft.grapple_line.desc: Throw a line at the block you're looking at and pull yourself to it.
ability.skillcraft.shadowstep.desc: Slip behind the enemy you're looking at. Your next strike hits harder.
ability.skillcraft.ironhide.desc: Toughen your skin: take a little less damage.
ability.skillcraft.keen_edge.desc: Your melee hits strike a little harder.
ability.skillcraft.steady_aim.desc: Your arrows hit a little harder.
ability.skillcraft.inner_flame.desc: Your spells hit a little harder.
ability.skillcraft.stoneskin.desc: Skin like stone: take less damage.
ability.skillcraft.ward_of_steel.desc: A ward that turns aside melee blows.
ability.skillcraft.ward_of_arrows.desc: A ward that turns aside arrows and missiles.
ability.skillcraft.ward_of_sorcery.desc: A ward that turns aside magic.
ability.skillcraft.saving_grace.desc: Cheat death once: a killing blow leaves you standing, but spends all your Faith.
ability.skillcraft.twinfang.desc: A quick follow-up cut with the blade in your off hand.
ability.skillcraft.torchbrand.desc: Strike, then thrust the torch in your off hand at the target to set it alight.

ability.skillcraft.detail.cleanse: Removes slows, roots and stuns; immune for %ss
ability.skillcraft.detail.damage_spell: Damage: %s%% of your focus's power, as %s
ability.skillcraft.detail.chain: Jumps to %s more enemies within %s blocks (-%s%% each)
ability.skillcraft.detail.ground_target: Aim up to %s blocks away; lands after %ss
ability.skillcraft.detail.recall: Returns you to your bed (or the world spawn)
ability.skillcraft.detail.dash_look_3d: Teleport: up to %s blocks where you look
ability.skillcraft.detail.dash_move: Dash: %s blocks the way you're moving
ability.skillcraft.detail.dash_block: Pull: to a block up to %s blocks away
ability.skillcraft.detail.dash_behind_ta: Step: behind an enemy up to %s blocks away
ability.skillcraft.detail.saving_grace: A killing blow leaves you at %s%% health; spends all Faith
ability.skillcraft.detail.drain_faith: Drains %s Faith per second while on

message.skillcraft.ley_full: The altar holds a different essence or is full. Weave what's on it first.

minigame.skillcraft.steady_the_current: Hold to push the current, let go to let it drift back. Keep it in the band as each pulse lands.
tooltip.skillcraft.ley_essence: Ley essence: worth %s ley shard at a Ley Altar
tooltip.skillcraft.ley_weave: Woven at a Ley Altar: %s %s, %s XP per shard
tooltip.skillcraft.ley_altar: Weaves shards into motes of whichever element its surroundings resonate with: lava, ice, lightning rods or amethyst
